reuse.why: Changes the existing shared getExpectedScheduleAmount that every schedule path (forecast, app, preview, template) already calls.

duplication.why: No logic is duplicated; the rule is replaced in its single definition.

placement.why: The rule stays in shared/schedules.ts where the tree defines expected schedule amounts.

scope.why: Focused, but includes an unrelated import reorder in server/schedules/app.ts.

maintainability.why: The now-meaningless rounding parameter is kept as an unused `_rounding` and schedule-template.ts still computes and passes 'template', leaving a dead option that misleads readers.

one_place.where: packages/loot-core/src/shared/schedules.ts getExpectedScheduleAmount, used by forecast-schedules.ts, schedules/app.ts, schedule-template.ts and computeSchedulePreviewTransactions.
